text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: MADE SAiNT
MS-TM01 · TRAIL MULE · PROTOTYPE 001 · REV A
SHEET 08 / 08

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Prototype sequence
04 / POWDER BLUE · FOG GRID · US M 12 2E

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: A Verify
Swatch the ripstop. Confirm powder blue and whether the white grid is actually in the cloth. Identify a US M 12 2E
last and a black sole with a raised wall and a round toe bumper. Do not cut yet.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: B Trace
Tape the last. Trace the feather, the opening, and the sole cavity. Rebuild sheets 02 and 06 on that trace. Retire
this proportion model.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: C Mock
Paper or cheap-cloth upper. Check the open heel, the collar height, and the logo-tab position against the card.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: D Upper
Stabilize only after a bond test. Sew the shell, foam, and lining. Roll the collar in the shell cloth. Stitch the logo
tab on the heel collar. Deboss or stamp from the wordmark file.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: E Footbed
Fit cork to the cavity. Laminate microfiber. Place the supplied art head-to-toe, wordmark toward the heel. Rub-test a
spare.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: F Bottom
Rough and cement per the adhesive sheet. Wipe squeeze-out. Do not add a separate rand if the sole already has the
wall.

text.font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: G Check
Forefoot clearance, heel retention, level sole, no early separation, collar comfort, art still readable. Record
changes as revision 002.
Full tools, adhesive, and QC text is in manual/MS-TM01-prototype-construction.md. One handmade pair. Not certified outdoor footwear.
SCALE NTS · PROPORTION MODEL FROM THE REFERENCE CARD · NOT A MEASURED DRAWING · PROVISIONAL — PHYSICAL VALIDATION REQUIRED
WORDMARK STAND-IN: MADE / SAiNT, LOWERCASE i REQUIRED. MATCH THE FOUNDER FILE. DO NOT CUT FROM THIS SHEET.
